submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I focused on the region closest to BiVO4 (Bi:V near 1:1, low Cu). BiVO4 is the known visible-light photoanode phase at 2.72 eV. Photocurrent went up steadily as the composition became more V-rich: idx110 (Bi-rich) gave 1.5e-6 A, idx34 gave 1.26e-5 A and idx0 (Bi0.36 Cu0.18 V0.46) gave 2.65e-5 A, the highest measured.

rejected.reason: Bi-rich, far from BiVO4 stoichiometry; 1.5e-6 A
Not measured because of the budget; Cu-rich phases are expected to show poorer photoanode activity than BiVO4-like compositions
